target_name: Cash Earnings With Dual Liquidity Cushion
rationale: This is a cosmetic one-leg swap on the already-tested "Funding Horizon Pooled With Maturity Structure" (same profitability leg, same MIN, same runway component), and the claim that cash-to-opex and wcap/lt occupy "non-overlapping balance-sheet regions" is factually wrong since wcap contains cash and current liabilities, so the promised noise reduction is unlikely to materialize.

The substitutes-versus-hurdles aggregation question was already answered in the archive by "Graded Versus Hard Complementarity" (MUL versus MIN on essentially the same content, delivering near-identical alpha and slope), so re-running it with SUMRANK on legs that are themselves both archived is a low-information mechanical variant rather than a new economic hypothesis.

target_name: Runway Under A Repeat Of The Worst Year
rationale: The stress-scenario construction genuinely fuses the two channels that previously split (trough earnings gave slope but no alpha, cash runway gave alpha but no slope) into a single monotone quantity with the numerator/denominator logic internally consistent with the stated positive sign, and it is not a relabeling of any archived expression.

The expression adds a bounded IND_RANK (roughly 0–1) to an unbounded z-score-times-indicator term whose dispersion is several times larger, so the composite is dominated by the already-tested profitability-flip signal and does not implement the stated "profitable-liquid at the top, profitable-illiquid at the bottom" ordering; it is also a linear blend of two archived signals rather than a new mechanism.

Both the exact leg pair (in product form, alpha −5.6%, t −5.0) and the MAX-aggregation question (gen-3 "Hazard Set By Worst Dimension") are already in the archive, and since MAX of two ranks discards the interaction that made the product work, this is a low-upside aggregation rerun rather than a substantively different idea.

target_name: Liquidity And Earned Cushion Without Current Profits
rationale: This is a clean, well-motivated ablation — dropping the current-profitability leg entirely to test whether the priced state is stock-of-resilience rather than profitability-times-distress — the leg pair has not been tested, and the expression's direction matches the stated positive sign; the main caveat is that re/lt is a classic Altman/Zmijewski ingredient, so a strong result will need to be checked against the known distress-score literature.
